ToneTinkerer for Linux (x86_64, X11)

1. Copy ToneTinkerer.vst3 to  ~/.vst3/
   Copy ToneTinkerer.clap to  ~/.clap/
   (Create the folders if they do not exist.)

2. Restart your DAW (or rescan plugins). It appears as "ToneTinkerer"
   by GuitarWiring.

Playing: a track with your interface's guitar input, record-armed with input
monitoring on, ToneTinkerer as its first effect. 48 kHz and a buffer of
64-128 samples work best. Pick a sound and play: the input level sets itself
during your first seconds of playing.

Next time, the easiest way to install or update is one line (in Terminal):

   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tinkercaster/tonetinkerer/main/scripts/install.sh | bash

Free and open source (MIT): https://github.com/Tinkercaster/tonetinkerer
